Because the person is asking you to do a good deed you cannot refuse it, but it is also difficult to carry out the minnat within the period of time the friend gives. For this reason I was wondering if it is alright to tell the person to 1. not make such excessive minnats that you can't fulfill yourself 2. to pray or carry out the good deed before you make the duaa (since making minnat is sort of like playing with allah). answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 151293 Country: INDIA Title: Will an oath be valid if it is made in the heart without uttering it? Question: Will an oath be valid if it is made in the heart without uttering it? Answer ID: 151293 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1049/1062/M=9/1438) It is necessary that the words of oath are uttered verbally. The oath shall not take place merely by saying in the heart. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
